description_en: Updates the proxy node of a cluster instance to the latest version
description_zh: 升级集群版实例代理节点 proxy 到最新的版本
name: UpgradeProxy

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the proxy nodes that you want to update. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). This parameter is valid only for Redis Open-Source Edition classic instances
parameters.help_zh: 要升级的代理节点id，使用英文小写逗号分隔。该参数仅对经典版实例有效
parameters.name: proxy_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The time to execute the specification change. Valid values:

Immediately (default): immediately executes the change.
MaintainTime: executes the change during the maintenance window of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61000.html operation to modify the maintenance window of an instance
parameters.help_zh:
变更规格的执行时间，取值：
Immediately：默认值，立即执行。
MaintainTime：实例可运维时间段内执行。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473775.html修改Redis实例的可维护时间段
parameters.name: switch_time_mode
